# ABINESH K
**Electronics & Communication Engineering Student | IoT & Embedded Systems Enthusiast**  
📍 Namakkal, Tamil Nadu, India | 📱 +91 6383628239 | 📧 [abiabineshk4647@gmail.com](mailto:abiabineshk4647@gmail.com)  
🔗 [LinkedIn Profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/abinesh-k-232030389?utm_source=share_via&utm_content=profile&utm_medium=member_android)

---

## 💡 PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Motivated ECE undergraduate with a strong academic foundation (94.8% in Diploma in Computer Science) and practical experience in **Embedded Systems**, **IoT Cloud Solutions**, **AI Signal Analysis**, and **AutoCAD**. Passionate about learning cutting-edge hardware-software integration and building a rewarding career in the Electronics & Semiconductor sector.

---

## 🛠️ TECHNICAL SKILLS
- **Embedded Systems & IoT:** Embedded System Fundamentals, Circuit Prototyping, Sensor Interfacing, Cloud Database Telemetry
- **Microcontrollers:** Arduino UNO, ESP32 (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth), STM32 Platform (NanoEdge AI)
- **Electronics & Semiconductors:** Electronics Fundamentals, Semiconductor Devices, Circuit Safety & Relays
- **Design & Programming:** AutoCAD Basics, Technical Drawing, Programming Fundamentals (C/C++, Logic Flow)

---

## 🚀 PROJECTS (All Single-Page Featured)

### 1. AI Based Wireless Jamming Detection — Moving Prototype
- Built an AI-powered prototype for real-time detection of wireless jamming signals using advanced signal analysis techniques.
- Demonstrated interference detection and instant alert generation on a moving platform to enhance wireless communication security.

### 2. Transformer Monitoring Management and Automation
- Designed an IoT system to measure key transformer parameters (voltage, current, temperature) and transmit live data to a cloud database.
- Implemented automated fault detection logic that instantly trips and disconnects the power supply to protect transformers from burnout.

### 3. Lorry Load Limit Control System
- Developed a vehicle load monitoring system using a high-precision load cell sensor to measure goods weight in real-time.
- Programmed threshold comparison logic to display load values and trigger automated warning alarms whenever preset weight limits are exceeded.

---

## 🎓 EDUCATION

### B.E in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
**Government College of Engineering, Salem-11** | *2024 – 2027*

### Diploma in Computer Science
**Muthayammal Polytechnic College, Namakkal (637001)** | *March 2023*
- **Percentage Scored:** **94.8%**

---

## 💼 WORK EXPERIENCE & WORKSHOPS

### Student Intern — Embedded Systems
**Emglitz Technologies, Salem, India**
- Completed intensive practical internship program focusing on Embedded System design, microcontroller programming, and hardware debugging.

### Workshop — Smart Embedded Systems: AI Powered Solutions
**COMPCOM 2025 @ Government College of Engineering, Salem**
- Attended hands-on technical workshop on STM32 microcontrollers and Edge AI solutions using NanoEdge AI.
